A '''Shaak-hide holster''' was a [[Holster/Legends|holster]] made from the hide of a [[Shaak/Legends|Shaak]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] used one to carry her [[ELG-3A blaster pistol/Legends|Naboo Royal pistol]].
